newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes higher on dollar at 1,012.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes higher on dollar at 1,012.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed higher against the dollar at 1,012 in active trading on the country's interbank market.
Dealers attributed the rise to speculative trading, but they said a slight rise in interbank lending rates had also lent support to the local currency.
The peso reached an intraday high of 1,010.90 to the dollar before dipping lower ahead of the close.
Dealers reported 386 trades for a total of $144 million and said the peso was widely expected to extend its trading gains on Friday.
